disconfirming_evidence: A direct substitute offers overlapping projections and procurement functions for €2,500 per year, SAP is bundling cash-impact forecasting, and no importer has signed or paid for the proposed exposure-register workflow.
reopen_condition: Multiple prepaid implementations with covered importers, evidence that the register changes a treasury or procurement decision or avoids costs exceeding its fee, conversion to prepaid quarterly retainers, at least two renewal cycles, observed sales-cycle and CAC data, delivery-hour records, fully loaded contribution margins, and signed workflow/data agreements. A direct comparison showing better decision value or lower total implementation burden than Carbon Glance and SAP-centered alternatives would materially improve confidence.

structure.control_point: Forecast used before procurement and certificate budgeting

working_limiter: The redesigned workflow remains unsigned and replaceable, with no proof that its incremental decision value supports the proposed recurring price beside cheap specialist software and bundled ERP functionality.

disconfirming_evidence: Specialist software already offers evidence collection, audit history, regulatory exports, and broker white-labelling for £199-£699 per month, while SAP can bundle exposure analysis into existing enterprise workflows.
holdout_objection: There is no demonstrated reason for importers to buy and renew a separate service at attractive fully loaded economics when defaults, low-priced specialist software, brokers, and SAP can cover or bundle much of the workflow.
reopen_condition: Paid pilots with several in-scope importers should establish the budget owner, diagnostic price, sales cycle, fully loaded CAC, delivery and support hours, contribution margin, and conversion to a paid second cycle. Evidence should also quantify when the default-versus-actual analysis changes a decision or saves more than the service and verification cost, and include signed data-use and retention rights plus at least one repeatable direct or referral acquisition channel.
working_limiter: There is still no demonstrated reason for importers to pay a separate premium service, nor evidence that direct acquisition, renewal, and bounded delivery costs yield attractive fully loaded economics against cheap and bundled alternatives.

disconfirming_evidence: Direct substitutes already perform or bundle the same work: one provider advertises payment-application preparation for PLN 200, installers and energy specialists offer administration or settlement free with broader purchases, and public operators support eligible beneficiaries through final settlement.
reopen_condition: Paid pilots with unrelated installers showing realized price, defect prevention, turnaround and repeat purchases; fully loaded case economics including rework, specialist escalation, insurance and acquisition cost; signed service, referral and data-processing agreements; a legal and insurance review defining the permissible scope; and measured evidence that integrations or a permissioned defect corpus produce a durable accuracy or speed advantage over bundled substitutes.

structure.critical_dependency: Reviewer accuracy and stable program rules

working_limiter: The standalone service has no demonstrated differentiation or defensible control point against low-priced, free-bundled and public substitutes, while its pricing and fully loaded economics remain unvalidated.

disconfirming_evidence: ZnanyLekarz already sells reminders, online payments, waiting-list filling, statistics, and external integrations in Poland, directly undermining the claimed differentiation; additionally, the cited randomized trial improved attendance without a statistically significant reimbursement increase.
reopen_condition: A paid Polish clinic pilot should show specialty-level baseline no-shows, cancellation timing, incremental filled visits against a credible control, collected recovered revenue, acceptance of the proposed subscription and performance fee, implementation and support hours, fully loaded contribution margin, CAC and sales cycle, renewal intent, and signed lawful access to scheduling, messaging, and attendance data. Evidence that the lift persists beyond incumbent reminders, waiting lists, or prepayment would be especially important.
working_limiter: The candidate does not control the scheduling workflow, patient channel, integration, or proprietary mechanism, while a strong incumbent already bundles most of the proposed functionality and can respond cheaply.

disconfirming_evidence: Existing vendors offer overlapping supplier, validation, ERP and official-system functionality at low advertised prices, and an authorised-representative mandate neither transfers operator responsibility nor creates durable exclusive control.
holdout_objection: The candidate has no demonstrated customer acquisition or fully loaded unit economics, while its replaceable, nonexclusive workflow position offers weak protection against established vendors with broader functionality and materially lower public pricing.
reopen_condition: The most valuable evidence would be two or more prepaid diagnostics from the defined beachhead that convert into signed 12-month operating contracts, accompanied by measured sales-cycle and CAC data, market-rate delivery and support hours, specialist and insurance costs, collected gross profit, six-month payback, supplier cooperation rates, and evidence that customers renew or expand despite the cited lower-priced incumbents.

structure.critical_dependency: Truthful upstream geolocation and legality data

working_limiter: There is still no signed importer commitment or evidence that direct diagnostics convert into profitable, renewable workflow contracts at sufficient scale.

disconfirming_evidence: A free browser-based substitute already validates EUDR GeoJSON, converts several common source formats, reprojects data to WGS84, and supports map-based boundary editing, indicating that basic normalization is a commodity feature rather than a strong standalone paid product.
reopen_condition: Several paid pilots with primary-duty operators showing the frequency and cost of invalid geometry, acceptance of the proposed pricing, observed remediation minutes and fully loaded contribution margin, renewal or repeat volume, and acquisition payback; signed channel or integration agreements; and contracts granting durable, lawful rights to retain anonymized error patterns would materially raise confidence.
working_limiter: The standalone function is weakly differentiated and economically unvalidated: free tools perform the basic normalization tasks, broader incumbents bundle them, and no direct evidence supports pricing, repeat usage, acquisition efficiency, or attractive fully loaded margins.

disconfirming_evidence: The US Department of Energy states that photovoltaic modules have no moving parts and require very little maintenance, undermining the assumed annual service cadence, homeowner urgency, recurring revenue pool, and consequently the platform's retention and revenue-share economics.
reopen_condition: A paid, consent-compliant pilot across a meaningful installed-base cohort showing homeowner offer rate, conversion, average service revenue, repeat frequency, fulfillment rate, refunds, installer retention, onboarding labor, fully loaded contribution margin, and CAC payback; followed by several unaffiliated signed installers and at least one repeatable distributor or direct-sales channel.

structure.control_point: Opt-in service renewal and payment event
structure.critical_dependency: Installer service capacity and homeowner conversion

working_limiter: The model depends on recurring homeowner service demand and installer willingness to share revenue, but the strongest available evidence indicates low routine PV maintenance needs and provides no observed conversion or fully loaded unit economics.

disconfirming_evidence: Poland's 2025 AI-use rate was only 8.4% across qualifying enterprises and 5.8% among small enterprises, while Microsoft and Google already bundle overlapping assistants into widely used productivity suites. Together, this supports the possibility that the apparent adoption gap reflects weak readiness or willingness to pay and that horizontal incumbents can compress the separate managed-service fee.
reopen_condition: Independent evidence from at least several target SMEs showing measured baseline labor or error costs, multiple paid pilots or deposits at the proposed price, realized net savings and acceptable error rates, renewals, fully loaded delivery and support time, an observed acquisition funnel and CAC, and proof that one standardized workflow can be deployed across firms. Signed customer authorizations and channel agreements, plus evidence of a reusable proprietary dataset or workflow asset, would materially strengthen control and defensibility.

structure.critical_dependency: Stable integrations and provable labor savings

working_limiter: The business currently lacks an owned control point or validated repeatable economics: buyer urgency, price acceptance, acquisition cost, support intensity, renewal, template transferability, and fully loaded margins are all unknown while powerful bundled substitutes already exist.

disconfirming_evidence: Low-cost PPWR tools, an incumbent specification platform, and consultants can cover the same underlying workflow, while no customer has signed the proposed authorization or paid for this managed offer.
reopen_condition: Multiple paid baselines and managed-service conversions at proposed prices; executed workflow and processing agreements; measured buyer savings, supplier response and exception-resolution improvements; account-level CAC, labor, specialist cost, contribution margin, quarterly renewal and expansion; and evidence that delivery can be delegated without quality loss.

structure.control_point: Evidence record used at packaging approval

working_limiter: The redesigned offer is still an unsigned, unvalidated and labor-intensive managed service with modest defensibility and uncertain renewal, CAC, capacity, and owner-earnings scalability.

disconfirming_evidence: SolarFleet already offers cross-brand integrations, fault detection, standards-based reporting, self-service onboarding, and annual per-site pricing of roughly GBP 3-5 monthly, while Fronius bundles extensive monitoring and yield analysis for free; this directly undermines differentiation and pricing power.
reopen_condition: Paid pilots with a sharply defined Polish buyer segment; measured conversion, price realization, renewal intent, CAC, sales cycle, connector and support costs; executed telemetry and data-processing rights; and blinded asset results showing accurate fault attribution, recovered value, low false-positive rates, and superiority over vendor and cross-brand substitutes.

structure.control_point: Independent performance baseline and exception record

working_limiter: The offer lacks a validated buyer and a strong advantage over entrenched free or inexpensive monitoring substitutes, while its essential telemetry and outcome data are not controlled.

disconfirming_evidence: Incumbents already offer quotations, document management, completeness checks and compliance-oriented workflows, while Hydo provides margin calculation and unlimited quotations for 89 PLN net monthly and SolarEdge bundles proposal functionality at no additional fee; this directly challenges both differentiation and the proposed 900-1,800 PLN monthly price.
reopen_condition: Permissioned analysis of at least 50 historical cases showing frequent, preventable and economically material errors; several independent installer interviews followed by paid pilots at or near target pricing; measured reduction in margin loss or handover delay; observed onboarding, support and rule-maintenance costs; renewal or continued-use evidence; and a repeatable acquisition test with documented CAC and conversion would support a materially higher score.

structure.control_point: Rules engine inserted before quote approval and final handover
structure.critical_dependency: Installer adoption and permissioned workflow examples

working_limiter: The candidate has not established a sufficiently differentiated, high-value paid wedge against capable bundled incumbents and much cheaper substitutes, leaving willingness to pay, retention, and scalable economics highly uncertain.

disconfirming_evidence: Partly already offers live multi-supplier price and availability, delivery optimization, unified ordering, supplier connections, and white-label deployment, while RepairDesk bundles inventory and integrated parts ordering into paid repair-shop software. Together they contradict both the premise that the mechanism is broadly missing and the expectation of strong bundling resistance.
reopen_condition: A paid pilot across one tightly defined category with at least two signed distributor data and fulfillment agreements and 20 or more shops, showing quote-to-order conversion, repeat monthly usage, order frequency, average order value, realized take rate, refunds, disputes, support cost, contribution margin, churn, CAC, and payback; agreements should specify durable data rights, SLA obligations, customer ownership, renewal, revocability, and transferability. Competitive tests should also show materially better coverage, completion prediction, or economics than bundled shop software and direct substitutes.

structure.control_point: Compatibility and availability graph at quote time
structure.critical_dependency: Nonexclusive supplier data and fulfillment agreements

working_limiter: The business does not control its essential supply data, fulfillment access, distribution, or customer relationships, while direct and bundled substitutes exist and the exact demand and fully loaded economics remain unvalidated.
